doc: Exploration hotspots (Level._merge_explore_hotspots; scene.json wins on name clashes). Owner: exploration stream (documentation/C4_DESIGN.md §6). Every spot keeps >= 24 px from the story hotspots of C4_DESIGN.md §4.1 and lies in the walk area of the scene part that reaches it: x 60-690 = scene A (archive cellar, Alexei, open until c4a_open_door), x 730-1900 = scene C (Dienststollen 3 + Umsetzgleis, Alexei, open after c4a_open_door). `info` is the art contract for env-tunnels: stand = where Alexei stands (feet line y 300), focus = where the thing is painted (world px), what = what must be visible there. The engine reads only `hotspots` / `spawns`.

exp_sugar_mouse.what: hidden: under the lowest shelf board, a field mouse at a lump of sugar (small, at floor level, easy to miss)

exp_stamps.what: right end of the book shelves: a wooden stamp rack with hooks, rubber stamps hanging, one hook empty

exp_card_index.what: left end of Lev's desk: the freight office's personnel card index, a small oak cabinet with brass label frames

exp_lev_photo.what: on the desk under the green lamp: a small framed photo leaning against the lamp foot (a young woman holding a leaflet)

exp_samovar.what: a side table right of Lev: a brass samovar, two tea glasses in metal holders, one full

exp_stove.what: the cast-iron stove with its pipe up through the vault, a kettle, a pair of felt boots drying

exp_air_raid_sign.what: an enamel/painted 1941 sign on the wall left of the iron door: „Бомбоубежище – Служебный тоннель №3“ with a painted arrow

exp_field_phone.what: a niche in the tunnel wall: a 1941 field telephone in a wooden case, the handset on a hook, its cable along the wall

exp_cables.what: cable runs along the tunnel vault: old cloth-wrapped cables on 1941 hooks and, clamped beside them, a new black rubber cable

exp_lever_frame.what: mini-game spot: a waist-high 1941 mechanical lever frame (eight levers, handles black/blue/red, brass number plates) beside switch W2; a small track diagram board above it

exp_child_drawing.what: hidden: at the tunnel mouth a low stack of rough bench boards (taken out of a wagon); a small house scratched into the top board

exp_stovepipes.what: the conversion kit: a heap of stove-pipe elbows, a small iron stove, zinc buckets, bench brackets

exp_painters_corner.what: between the siding office and the paint stand: a crate as table, tea glasses, a folded newspaper, a duty roster nailed to the post

exp_plate_heap.what: left of the wagon: a heap of enamel wagon number plates, a dozen numbers, some freshly overpainted

exp_task_beam.what: side task „Wir sind vierzehn“ (1/4): the small air hatch at the left end of wagon 24 318 (painted, x ~1560-1572, y ~192-200); inside, unseen, three names written in stove soot on the roof beam

exp_task_pipe.what: side task (2/4): the stove pipe through the wagon roof (painted, x ~1612, y ~150-180) with its sooty collar; behind it inside, four names scratched with a nail

exp_task_bench.what: side task (3/4): through the half-open sliding door the dark interior and the front plank bench (painted, x ~1652-1676, y ~230-240); under it four names, seven tally strokes

exp_task_rail.what: side task (4/4): the running rail of the sliding door right of the opening (painted, x ~1650-1757, y ~191), the paint scratched to the iron where the door stops: three names and „21.1.“

exp_wagon_marks.what: the right end of wagon 24 318: stencilled maintenance marks on the frame (revision dates, depot code), one line painted over

exp_exit_portal.what: the exit portal to the main line, gate shut, a padlock; daylight lines through the gaps
